subject: Renewal: incidental-usage uplift and MSA amendments for FY27
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: contracts@newscope.ai, emma.wong@newscope.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01 09:15 PST
Subject: Renewal: incidental-usage uplift and MSA amendments for FY27

Hi Emma / NewScope Contracts team,

Following our commercial alignment call last week (Tom + Marissa + Soojin), I’m sharing the draft MSA and the proposed order form that reflect the renewal and the incidental-usage uplift we discussed. Key changes to highlight:

- Term: moving to an 18-month renewal window starting 2027-01-01.
- Capacity: committed GPU-hours increased from 120k to 300k (2.5x) across the term; billing tiers updated in OrderForm_v3.xlsx.
- Incidental usage: proposed carve for short-burst inference spikes (Section 2.3) — calls out 48-hour burst windows and a separate consumption line item.
- SLAs: minor tweaks to latency SLA thresholds for burst periods and an adjustment to service credit calculation for partial-day outages.

Attachments: MSA_v4_draft.docx and OrderForm_v3.xlsx.

Could you review the attached and send annotated redlines on the MSA (we’d appreciate PDF annotations) and any questions on the order form by end of next week? If helpful, Marissa (CS lead) and Lauren (legal) are cc’d and can join a legal-to-legal call.

High level ask: confirm whether NewScope can accept the incidental-usage carve (Section 2.3) and the revised indemnity boundary we proposed on page 7. If not, please flag specific language you’d like changed.

Thanks — I'll coordinate a short call once we see your notes.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: MSA_v4_draft.docx (word), OrderForm_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@newscope.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@newscope.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02 11:03 PST
Subject: Re: Renewal: incidental-usage uplift and MSA amendments for FY27

Thanks Soojin — we reviewed and attached an annotated PDF (MSA_annotated_newscope.pdf). High level: we’re supportive of the term and capacity numbers but have three items we need clarified / revisited before we can sign:

1) Indemnity carve: we can’t accept the proposed limitation that removes third-party data-exfiltration claims from Redwood’s indemnity. We need a mutual indemnity for third-party claims arising from a breach attributable to the vendor.

2) Incidental usage/burst billing: the 48-hour carve is reasonable, but we want an explicit monthly cap on burst units (Section 2.3). Please advise whether that can be added (suggested cap: 40% of committed capacity per month).

3) Audit & logs retention: NewScope needs 24 months of access to audit logs for compliance; the draft references 12 months.

We attached line-item comments. Also flagged two SOW definitions that reference ‘internal-only telemetry’ — please confirm the telemetry data classification (PII vs non-PII).

We can do a 30-minute legal call on Friday 12/04 at 10:30 PST if that works for Redwood.

—Emma
Emma Wong
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | NewScope.ai
emma.wong@newscope.ai

Attachments: MSA_annotated_newscope.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@newscope.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-03 09:47 PST
Subject: Re: Renewal: incidental-usage uplift and MSA amendments for FY27

Emma — thanks for the quick review and the annotated PDF. I captured our responses inline below (excerpted for clarity). Please see attached MSA_redlines_answered.pdf and OrderForm_comments.xlsx for tracked language.

On Dec 2, 2026, at 11:03 AM, Emma Wong <emma.wong@newscope.ai> wrote:
> 1) Indemnity carve: we can’t accept the proposed limitation that removes third-party data-exfiltration claims from Redwood’s indemnity.

We can accept a mutual indemnity approach for third-party claims but need to preserve Redwood's limitation of liability for consequential damages. Proposed compromise: mutual indemnity for third-party IP and data breach claims caused by a party’s gross negligence or willful misconduct. We are not agreeing to an open-ended vendor indemnity for NewScope’s downstream customers where Redwood had no control.

> 2) Incidental usage/burst billing: asked for an explicit monthly cap of 40% of committed capacity.

We proposed the 48-hour burst window to avoid complex monthly overage disputes. We can add an optional monthly cap as a negotiable metric (Section 2.3 amendment) to be set by mutual agreement after first quarter usage telemetry. Suggested language: ‘Customer and Vendor will review burst consumption at the end of Q1 and agree on a monthly cap in writing; absent agreement, a default ramp of 20% per month applies.’

> 3) Audit & logs retention: NewScope needs 24 months; draft says 12 months.

We can extend retention to 18 months as a middle ground; 24 months requires additional storage/ops commitments and impact to pricing. If NewScope requires 24 months, we’ll need to reflect a small storage line item on the order form — see OrderForm_comments.xlsx.

Next steps:
- If NewScope can accept the mutual indemnity-for-gross-negligence compromise + 18-month retention, Redwood will produce a tracked MSA for signature.
- I’m happy to join the Friday legal call at 10:30 PST to walk through open points. Marissa — can you confirm the revised order-form pricing impact for an optional 24-month retention and a 40% monthly burst cap?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MSA_redlines_answered.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_comments.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@newscope.ai>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@newscope.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-04 14:22 PST
Subject: Re: Renewal: incidental-usage uplift and MSA amendments for FY27

Emma / Sam — thanks for the notes and for proposing the call. Quick summary and proposed path to sign:

- Indemnity: Redwood will accept a mutual indemnity tied to gross negligence or willful misconduct; Redwood retains limitation of liability for consequential damages.
- Burst cap: we’ll add a placeholder monthly cap mechanism to Section 2.3 with the Q1 review cadence; if NewScope wants an immediate 40% cap we’ll roll that into the pricing model.
- Logs retention: propose 18 months as compromise; if NewScope mandates 24 months, we’ll add a storage surcharge line on the order form.

Attached is a DocuSign pre-sign envelope for the order form and a proposed call invite (I’ll send invite for 12/04 10:30 PST as suggested). If the legal points above are acceptable in principle, we can run the tracked MSA this afternoon and target signature next week.

Please confirm whether Sam or Emma should join the legal-to-legal only call, or if you prefer an expanded session with procurement and CS.

Thanks — will follow up with the calendar invite and the DocuSign link.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
